column1: # This file freezes the lexicon entries that carry no delivery classification
# yet. It is a MIGRATION EXCEPTION SET, not a second catalogue of shelf lives:
# every line here says "nobody has classified this key", and the only legal
# The fingerprint is of the entry's TEXT, not of its classification. So a key
# cannot be reworded under cover of its exemption, cannot be edited and left
# unclassified, and cannot be quietly re-added after it has been converted -
# changing the words changes the fingerprint, and the gate then asks for the
# classification the entry should have gained.
# A key that is CLASSIFIED must not appear here. A key that is NOT classified
# must. The test that enforces both is
# Delete this file when the last line leaves it.
# The 222 alarms.* entries were QUARANTINED (commented out) from 2026-09-25 to
# 2026-10-01 under #627, while Track I was unmerged and their keys did not
# exist here. Track IJK restored them when it brought Track I in. A commented
# entry is now a defect, and LegacyUnclassifiedQuarantineTests says so.
